controles.affirmation: Reglementaire : le ratio Solvabilite II passe de 224% a 218%, dont -10 pts lies a la fin de la periode de grandfathering au 1er janvier 2026, 2,4 Mds€ de dettes ayant perdu leur eligibilite
controles.verbatim_source: Presentation S1 2026 (31/07/2026), page "Solvency II at 218%" : pont "Solvency II ratio FY25 224% -10pts 215% +2pts +17pts 0pt -4pt -12pts 0pt 218%" avec les libelles "Impact of the end of the grandfathering period", "Regulatory & model changes", "Normalized capital generation", "Operating variance", "Economic variance & FX", "Dividend & annual share buy-back", "Management actions, debt & other". EOF 56,4 aux deux dates, SCR 25,2 puis 25,8. Note : "€2.4bn debts that lost eligibility for Solvency II purposes on 1st January 2026 are presented as senior debt". Rapport S1 2026 : "the Group's Eligible Own Funds (EOF) amounted to €56.4 billion and the Solvency II ratio to 218%, compared to €56.4 billion and 224%, respectively, as of December 31, 2025".

controles.affirmation: Reglementaire/risque : AXA place le credit prive et les actifs prives en tete de ses facteurs de risque 2025, le document precisant que les risques sont presentes par ordre de materialite
controles.verbatim_source: URD 2025, chapitre 5.1 : "These risks are presented below in order of their materiality according to that assessment, which takes into account the likelihood that they may materialize and the expected magnitude of their negative impact on the Group. The primary categories of risk are: market-related risks; credit and liquidity-related risks; ..." ; dans la premiere categorie : "the recent marked increase in private credit and associated concerns around origination and underwriting practices, as well as credit quality" et "repricing and liquidity strains or other stresses impacting private debt and private equity".

controles.affirmation: Sensibilite du ratio : -18 pts si le capital investissement et les infrastructures baissent de 25%, contre -7 pts (spreads souverains euro +50pb), -5 pts (swaps d'inflation +50pb) et -3 pts (migration de notation : 20% des obligations d'entreprises degradees de 3 crans)
controles.verbatim_source: Presentation S1 2026, tableau de sensibilites : "PE & Infra +25% +14 pts", "PE & Infra -25% -18 pts", "Euro Sovereign spreads +50bps -7 pts", "Inflation swap curve +50bps -5 pts", "Credit migration -3 pts" ; note : "20% of corporate bonds (including private debt) held are downgraded by one full letter (3 notches)". Annexe General Account Invested Assets HY26 : Fixed income 346 (76%), Private Credit 48 (10%) dont below investment grade & non-rated 13, Total return assets 87 (19%), Real Estate & Infra Equity 51 (11%), Listed & Private Equity 29 (6%), General Account Assets 454, participating 60%, Duration gap -0,4y.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 1 : BPA operationnel +8% au S1 2026 dont +4% de croissance des resultats, +6% de gestion du capital et -3% de change ; resultat operationnel +1,6% en publie a 4 537 M€ ; actions moyennes 2 033 contre 2 157 millions
controles.verbatim_source: Presentation S1 2026 : "+4% from earnings growth", "+6% from capital management", "-3% from FX", note "Change at constant FX for underlying earnings and net income. Change on reported basis for underlying earnings per share". Rapport S1 2026 : "On a reported basis, Underlying Earnings amounted to €4,537 million, up €73 million (+2%). On a constant exchange rate basis, Underlying Earnings increased by €200 million (+4% or +9% excluding AXA Investment Managers... whose contribution to Underlying Earnings was €+175 million in the first half of 2025)". BPA operationnel dilue 2,19 € contre 2,03 €, actions moyennes 2 033 / 2 157. Nombre d'actions 2021-2025 : 2 421,569 / 2 351,771 / 2 270,189 / 2 214,798 / 2 090,622 M (-13,67%).
controles.correction_proposee: AXA ecrit "+2%" pour la progression publiee du resultat operationnel ; l'ATT calcule 1,6% a partir des deux montants publies (4 537 vs 4 465). Le calcul est exact mais s'ecarte du pourcentage publie : signaler qu'il s'agit d'un recalcul.

controles.affirmation: "Le MEME SCHEMA existait en 2025 : +8% de BPA dont +6% de croissance des resultats et +3% de gestion du capital"
controles.verbatim_source: Presentation FY2025 : "+6% from earnings growth", "+3% from capital management", "including -1% from temporary earnings dilution from AXA IM sale", BPA 3,59 -> 3,86 (+8%). En 2025 la croissance des resultats (+6) apporte DEUX FOIS PLUS que la gestion du capital (+3) ; au S1 2026 le rapport s'inverse (+4 contre +6). Les chiffres cites sont exacts, mais ils contredisent la these du paragraphe ("le rachat d'actions apporte davantage que l'activite") plutot qu'ils ne la confirment.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer "Le meme schema existait en 2025" par "Le rapport s'est inverse depuis 2025 : le groupe indiquait alors +8% de BPA dont +6% de croissance des resultats et seulement +3% de gestion du capital".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 2 : marge sur affaires nouvelles a 4,3% au S1 2026 contre 4,6% ; NBV 1 143 M€ (-1,2% comparable) pour 26 853 M€ de primes attendues (+6,3%) ; series annuelles 5,3% / 5,0% / 4,4% / 4,5% et NBV 2 288 / 2 281 / 2 264 / 2 233 M€
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport S1 2026 : "NBV decreased by -3% on a reported basis and -1% on a comparable basis to €1,143 million, as NB CSM growth was offset by an unfavorable mix on short-term business" ; "NB CSM decreased by -4% on a reported basis and increased by +0.5% on a comparable basis to €1,113 million... Excluding the impact from higher interest rates, notably in Japan, NB CSM would have increased by +3% on a comparable basis." Series kpis-haut CS.PA (source URD) : NBV 2 288 / 2 281 / 2 264 / 2 233 ; NBV margin 5,3 / 5,0 / 4,4 / 4,5 ; PVEP 43 320 / 45 856 / 50 896 / 49 357. CSM 34 185 au 30/06/2026 contre 33 164 un an plus tot.
controles.correction_proposee: Detail : la PVEP n'a pas progresse de facon monotone (50 896 en 2024 puis 49 357 en 2025) ; la formulation "progresse de 43,3 a 49,4 Mds€" ne vaut que d'un bout a l'autre de la periode.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 3 : capitaux propres part du groupe -10,5% en dix-huit mois (49 943 -> 47 171 -> 44 692 M€), dont -4 693 M€ de dividendes, -1 399 M€ d'actions autodetenues, -949 M€ d'interets sur dette perpetuelle, +4 171 M€ de resultat net ; ROE operationnel 18,3% contre 17,5% sur 48,7 contre 50,1 Mds€
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport S1 2026, tableau des capitaux propres : "47,171 ... Treasury Shares -1,399 ... Undated Subordinated Debt (including interest charges) -949 ... Dividends -4,693 ... Net Income for the Period 4,171 ... At June 30, 2026 44,692". Tableau ROE : "Underlying ROE 18.3% / 17.5% (0.8 pts)", "Average Adjusted Shareholders' Equity 48.7 / 50.1". Recalcul de l'ATT 18,3 x 48,7/50,1 = 17,79%. URD 2025 : capitaux propres 47 171 contre 49 943, resultat net 9 797, ecarts d'acquisition 17 799, autres incorporels 4 410 (total 22 209 = 47,1%). Debt gearing 21,7% contre 22,3%.

controles.affirmation: AXA XL : CA 11 055 M€ (-2,3% comparable, -5,9% publie), resultat operationnel 994 contre 1 024 M€, ratio combine 89,7% contre 88,6% ; reassurance -9% de volume avec tarifs -5%, assurance -1% avec tarifs -1%
controles.verbatim_source: Rapport S1 2026 : "AXA XL 11,055 11,749 -2.3%" (variations en base comparable) ; "AXA XL Insurance (-1%), reflecting disciplined cycle management in a softening market environment with pricing down -1%" ; "AXA XL Reinsurance decreased by 9% to Euro 1.8 billion, reflecting lower volumes, consistent with our focus on profitability in a softer market environment, with pricing down -5%" ; "An increase at AXA XL Insurance by (+1.1 points) due to losses in the Middle East (+1.1 points)" ; UNDERLYING EARNINGS GROUP SHARE AXA XL 994 ; Combined Ratio AXA XL 89,7%.

controles.affirmation: "AXA XL progresse de +3,8% en trois ans QUAND LE GROUPE PROGRESSE DE 14,5%"
controles.verbatim_source: URD 2023, Activity Indicators : "Gross Written Premiums & Other Revenues 102,733 101,844" — le CA groupe 2022 publie est de 101 844 M€. URD 2025 : CA 2025 = 115 524 M€. Recalcul : 115 524 / 101 844 - 1 = +13,4%, et non +14,5%. Le CA AXA XL 2022-2025 (18 577 / 18 417 / 19 383 / 19 277) donne bien +3,8%.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer "quand le groupe progresse de 14,5%" par "quand le groupe progresse de 13,4% (101 844 M€ en 2022, 115 524 M€ en 2025)". Le poids 2025 (19 277 / 115 524 = 16,7%) est exact.

controles.affirmation: Ratio combine 90,1% avec une charge nat cat de 3,5 pts sous la charge normalisee d'environ 4,5 pts ; ratio courant normalise non actualise hors Prima a 96,4% contre 98,0% en 2023 ; attritionnel +0,4 pt
controles.verbatim_source: Presentation S1 2026, page P&C : combined ratio 90,0% -> 90,1%, Nat Cat 3,5% aux deux periodes, CY attritional 66,7% (67,3% hors Prima) contre 67,0%. Page "Solid operational improvement across the businesses over the plan" : P&C margins FY23 98,0% -> 1H26 96,4% (-1,6 pt). Rapport S1 2026, Outlook : "The Group's guidance for normalized natural catastrophe load remains at ca. 4.5 points of combined ratio for 2026" ; "The current year undiscounted loss ratio excluding natural catastrophes was up +0.4 point". Cibles du plan : "underlying earnings per share growth at the upper end of the 6-8% CAGR target range", "underlying return on equity between 14% and 16%", "cumulative organic cash upstream in excess of Euro 21 billion for 2024-2026E", "a total payout ratio of 75%, comprising a 60% dividend payout ratio and an additional 15% from annual share buybacks".

controles.affirmation: CSM groupe 33 253 M€ fin 2025 contre 33 853 M€, stable depuis quatre ans, alors que le CA Vie et Sante progresse de 14,2% de 49,5 a 56,5 Mds€
controles.verbatim_source: URD 2025 : "financial position was €33,253 million (€33,853 million as of December 31, 2024)" ; series kpis-haut CSM 33 535 (2022) / 33 976 (2023) / 33 853 (2024) / 33 253 (2025), soit -0,8% sur trois ans. CA Vie & Sante : 2022 = 25,287 + 24,198 = 49,485 Mds€ ; 2025 = 29,230 + 27,282 = 56,512 Mds€, soit +14,2%.
